info.description: Content-only hero for event pages: background, event information and CTA buttons (no video or image). Use `eventDate` + `eventTime` (+ `eventEndsOn` for multi-day). These are timezone-naive: the admin stores exactly what you type, and the page prints exactly that, with `timeZone` as a label (18 Sep + 19:30 + IST renders 'September 18, 2026 · 7:30 PM IST'). No conversion, in either direction, for any visitor. The legacy datetime fields are still read as a fallback until every entry is migrated - do not use them for new entries; their picker shifts what you type by your own browser offset.
